# Goldrush (01, engineer) — BAD-068

## Brief
Give `cleanDisplay` and `displayForMember` in `server/supabase/functions/_shared/collab.mjs` real JSDoc signatures, and in the same change tighten `Caller.email` in `server/supabase/functions/collab/gate.ts` from `any` to `string`, replacing the seven-line apology comment that explains the lie.

Why the two halves must land together: `cleanDisplay(raw, email = null)` has no JSDoc, so TypeScript infers the second parameter as `null` and rejects a `string` argument (TS2345). Before BAD-047 the call sites compiled only because `email` inherited `any` from an untyped licence row — the check passed by accident. Typing `Caller.email` as `string` alone adds two TS2345s at the two `cleanDisplay(body.display, email)` calls (now in `collab/lobby.ts:21` and `:103`); adding the JSDoc alone leaves the `any` and its comment in place. Either half alone leaves the pair disagreeing.

`displayForMember({ handle = null, display = null, email = null } = {})` at :449 has the same shape and the same gap — its destructured defaults infer `null` too — so give it a JSDoc object-parameter signature as well, even though nothing currently passes it a bare `string` from a typed position.

Runtime behaviour must not change at all: both functions already coerce with `String(x == null ? '' : x)`. This is a types-and-comments change.

Establish the baseline before you touch anything, and record both numbers in your `member log`:

    deno check --node-modules-dir=none server/supabase/functions/collab/index.ts

`main` prints three TS7006 errors (implicit-any parameters) and nothing else. After your change it must print exactly those same three TS7006 errors — no TS2345, no new error, and none of the three removed; fixing the TS7006s is a different ticket and out of scope here. Note that `deno check` writes an ungitignored `deno.lock` at the repository root (that is BAD-069, already filed) — delete it before you stage anything and never commit it.

Then run the unit suite: `npm test`. `test/server/collab.test.mjs` already pins both functions' behaviour (`cleanDisplay falls back to the email local part, then a placeholder` at :238, `displayForMember never surfaces the email local part` at :199); those tests must stay green untouched, and if a JSDoc you write contradicts one of them, the JSDoc is wrong.

The comment you write in `gate.ts` replaces an apology with a fact. The old one says the field is `any` because `_shared/collab.mjs` forces it; once that is no longer true the field needs either a one-line comment saying what `email` is (the lower-cased `account_email` from the licence row, guaranteed non-empty because `authorize` fails with `no_email` when it is blank — see `gate.ts:81-82`) or no comment at all. Do not leave a stale reference to the old reason anywhere. Check whether `browse.ts:66-67` or any other comment points at the removed explanation.

`_shared/collab.mjs` is read by `web/`, `mobile/` and the Edge Functions alike, and is loaded in browsers by plain `<script type="module">` — so JSDoc comments only, never TypeScript syntax, never a `.d.ts`, and no change to the runtime source lines.
